headline: UPDATE Fines of over 52 million lei in the sugar market. Competition Council accuses an anti-competitive agreement for price fixing
summary: Romania's Competition Council has imposed fines of over 52 million lei in the sugar market. It accuses Agrana and Lucsor Impex of an anti-competitive price-fixing agreement.
why: Agrana is an Austrian food and sugar group with operations in Central and Eastern Europe, and fines for cartel conduct can affect its earnings and regional market position.
